en: Hmm... they send someone to wake you up in the morning, but... it doesn't say who. I guess I don't really care, but didn't I see an orc man working in the room across the hall?
Hmm? I'm fairly certain you aren't my next client. I'm not ready yet anyway. This isn't the sort of thing you can just do nonstop all day long you know.
How are things going for you today? Something more exciting than being a bodyguard for trollops, I hope.
Hoy. You uh... here for a drink?

Huh. You're for real? Looks like I'm your man then. Give me a minute to get my stuff. Oh, and call me Leftie. Left-handed and also because... well that part doesn't matter. See you when you're ready to go.
I ain't leaving for less than 1000$. They might pay me shit, but at least I get to sleep indoors.
I am sorry, but I am told that I now have appointments waiting. I must ask you to leave so I will have time to prepare.

I can give you a quick squeeze, if that's what you're looking for. Madame doesn't need to know about it, do she? It ain't full service, but you get to cut the line, and it'll only cost you 50$. Just shut the door and lay down.
I can hardly stand waiting anymore. If I don't get in soon, I'm going to break down and just drag one of these guys over to that empty room.

I complain about it, but this place here is about as safe as it gets on this island. As safe, and boring as it gets. Also, have you noticed how much this place smells like cocks? I think it's the Ettins.
I don't think I would classify those looks I am getting as
I heard about this place, but never actually been myself. I doubt they got anyone who can handle my timber though. Too bad.
I heard that they
I hope you enjoyed yourself. Recommend me to your friends, hmm?
I never managed to get here before on account of Frico's damn gatekeeping. I wonder if they got any lads who know what to do with rope.
I thought this place was an inn, not a brothel. I need a place to sleep though, so... I guess I'm hanging out here for a while.
I want to help you out, babe, I do, but I can't do you for free. Come back another time.
I was hopeful when I saw this place still standing. The spirits they used to brew were some of the best I've ever had.
I was hoping to have a meeting with Ms. Zianne, but I think her last client fell asleep on her.
I was uncomfortable thinking we were going into an alehouse, but now I am decidedly more uncomfortable. Is it truly necessary for us to be here?
I'm afraid there hasn't been a change on the waiting period. Unless you plan to stay around for a week or more, there's little I can do for you. My apologies.
I'm not sure whether to be glad the building is getting some use, or to mourn the whiskey.
I'm sure you'll find something you like. Do try to enjoy yourselves.
I'm... ah... well just call me Leftie, I guess. Cuz I'm left-handed, and also it kinda leans.. well you'll see, won't you? Why the fuck am I so nervous?
I've talked to a few people, and none of the clients have ever seen Ms. Zianne. I bet it's just a cute name for a dumb pet dog or something.
I... alright. I'll try.
If anyone asks, I am absolutely not a werewolf and I have never, ever been to Hayill. There was an incident a few years ago and we're kinda blacklisted here.
In any case, we are very popular. Our books are full well in advance. Our current waiting period to meet with someone is eight days.
It was a bit weird at first, but really, this island is nothing but men, men, men as far as the eye can see. If you don't push your boundaries, there's no surviving this place.
It's going to take me all day to restring this harp. Thank you again for the wire.
It's not every day I get a man as strong and handsome as you, you know.
Let the worries of the road fall away. For now, there is only this.
Like this Ms. Vivian?
Look, I'm not available. Check with the Madame if you want to make an appointment. Maybe one of the other ladies can see you.
Look, me and the Ettins can kick your ass if we have to. Just don't make trouble, alright? Please. It's a shit enough job as it is.
My appointments for the day are finished, so I have much time to spare. I can see you, if you like, for my standard fee. It will be 200$, and I will show you a tender hand.
My wife would kill me if she knew I was in a place like this.
No doubt. I can imagine what you'd ask in return for such a service as well!
No offense, Paul.
No.
None taken. It kinda does.
Not that I will ever see her again, of course. I'd like to think that she'd be understanding, but... I know she wouldn't.
Not too bad, hmm? I'd love to give you a bigger draught, but I gotta save something special for the full experience, hmm? Maybe make an appointment and ask for me. You won't regret it!
Of course you have.
Of course... it would be kinda nice to get a massage or something wouldn't it? I have a bit of coin, so maybe I'll... oh I don't know.
Oh God, I just realized, what if she's in there alone? Making that... noise?
Oh goodness! This might just do the trick. Here, let me give you something from my earnings.
Oh, I'm sorry dear. My last client really wrecked me. I'm taking the rest of the day off. I'm sure you understand.
Oh, come on, I don't bite. Not unless you pay me to.
Oh, hey, good timing. Zip me up, would you?
Oh, how fun! I love brothels! The women here always have such interesting stories, and they're usually tough as nails too! I wonder if they're all working, or if I can find someone to chat with.

Oh, sorry. I don't see many people who aren't here for their pound of flesh. And it is a whole pound, by the way. I weighed it.

Maybe come back later, hmm?
Oh, sure. Just slip me 500$ and give me a minute to go shave my legs, and I'll give you a ride on a wild boar. Give me a break.
Oh. This isn't an alehouse at all is it? Well why wouldn't they change the name, then? Why still call it the pump-
Oh... well shit. You weren't kidding. Well... meet me in the empty room, I guess.
Peregrine, for the price you'd ask, you'd need to throw in a serenade and a bottle of wine at a bare minimum!
Perfect, thanks. I'd give you a handy, but my next client is going to be here any minute. Busy, busy.
Perhaps I'll sit and wait while you... explore the premises. I think a fellow named Rugal wants to see you. Don't ask me how I know that.
Please do not toy with me. If you cannot afford my fee, leave and make room for someone who can.
Please!

Sadly, I think my harp is finished. Several of my strings have broken, and I cannot play without them. I have no idea where I'll be able to find wire delicate enough to serve as harp string. I'm afraid I cannot play for you today.
Shapiro, buddy, if you wanted someone to give you a bath, your good friend Peregrine is always happy to oblige!
Should I rent a room for you two?

Smells a bit like cocks though. Roses and cocks. 

I guess that can't be helped.
So I'm thinking we blow all these lonely guys for half price, and then pool the money and buy the most expensive whore in the house. Great idea, right?
Some of these girls make like 500$ for a single fuck, and they're sore about paying me 100$ and a crust of bread for a whole day. It's bullshit.
Sorry Vankan, I'm asking. How do you know Rugal?
Sorry, I'm just exhausted. I don't mean to be rude, but I need to rest.
Sorry, what? I was distracted by the stunning floral arrangements. Now, where do you think the bar is?

Thanks, huh? Feels good to be worth something for once, even if it's just worth a handful of coins.

Back to the crap job, though. Seeya later.
That older guy has been looking at me strangely for the last little while. Did I take his seat or something?
That's not true. You're so beautiful and I'm just a dumb scrub.
The same way I know how you know Rugal. I just do.
The waiting lists here are absurd! I had to book my appointment a week in advance and I still have to wait!
Then leave me alone. I have to keep an eye on all these poor sots in case one of them succumbs to boner rage.
There are too many people here, all eyeing each other like fish at market. I don't like it.
There we go. Found your spot, didn't I?
There's quite a few of us here, as you can see. I been waiting for hours already.
There, now we got that out of the way, you just huck your clothes and get comfortable, hmm? You're gonna enjoy this.
They're always booked solid here. Last time I was here, I ended up taking an appointment with Rugal because he was the only one available.
This is a pretty nice place. They must've worked hard to keep it in such good condition.
This place smells like the cheese from a giant's cockskin.
Too long? That's a pity. Do feel free to have a look around, though. Maybe you'll decide that it would be worth the wait after all.
Welcome to the Pumphouse, strangers.
Well hello again, darling.
Well hello again, sailor.
Well shit, that sounds like way more fun than sticking around here. If you want me along, I'll just go get my things! Come find me when you're ready to go.
Well you're an asshole. But thanks for the laugh anyway.
Well, ain't that great? The door fee is 200$. You want in, you pay up.
Well, get your ass gone then, and don't even think of starting trouble. You'd be surprised how ferociously these giants will defend folks to know how to share.
Well, that was interesting. Does that make me officially a whore now too? Add it to the list, I guess.
What am I gonna do if he's the
What the hell is taking him so long anyway? I hate it when my clients are late.
What you want to hire me? Long-term? You'll have to pay me better than that tight-ass Madame, not that it would be very difficult. I want 1000$ for the first week. We can talk more after that. Deal?
Who am I booked with? Oh, I'm booked with Rugal again. I asked for him this time. He was fantastic!
Why don't you strip off, and we'll see if I can give you your money's worth
Wow, I bet this place has tits for days! We have some time to kill, don't we? A few hours?
Yeah, just like that. You're very good at this game.
Yeah, that's right, you big boy! Put both your hands on it and play with it.
Yep.
Yes, just relax. Close your eyes, and just let me do everything.
Yo, nice to see you. You ain't my client, are you? Well, come on in anyway, and keep your voice down if you please.
You can't be seriously thinking of patronizing this demeaning hogsty? Just using these women for your momentary pleasure?
You know, they pay the giants in sex? They tried to pay me that way too, as if it's something I could eat. I demanded food and money, and they got all pissy with me.
You like rope? I know a thing or two about that, you know. Used to work as a sailor between jobs.
You like that, don't you?
You might want to watch yourself. Places like these, it's rare that there ain't someone with blood on his breath. I'd know.
You will not be disappointed. Close the door and lay down.
You've come to the right woman. Come in, sit down. Relax.
You've need of a diversion, Master? Well, by all means. I will stand guard and ensure your chosen whore does not attempt to harm you.
with the Ettins in order to get them to stand guard like that. Which unlucky girl do you think gets that job?

Back home, Evans had taken quite an interest in dark magic. This is hardly abnormal, as priests are often called upon to combat such magicks, but I believe he became infatuated with his studies, and began to dabble in the practice of the very arts he was trained to oppose.
Curse my foolishness. If only I hadn't lost my emblem, I'm sure I'd be able to unravel this sorcery.

Evans seemed unshaken by these events. When we arrived on Lukatt, his activities became bolder, less restricted. We found an abandoned building for shelter, and we hadn't much choice but to stay there.
He lost his way, somewhere down the line... but he was a good man. I should have done more to help him back on the right path. These past few months could have gone entirely differently.
He... he wasn't?
Here, I want you to have this. It used to belong to him, but it might prove useful to you. Please take it as a token of my thanks. And please, keep my emblem. I don't have any more use for it.
His emblem feels strange to me, so I dared not use it, but now that you've brought mine, I can dispel the barrier around this wall. Please stand back.
I am pastor Nikolai. Although, the 'pastor' part doesn't hold much meaning now.
I beg of you, please, tell me what you saw.
I found Evans' emblem and his robes here. He is inside, of that I am certain.
I know that I have no business asking this of you, but please... take my emblem, and find Evans.
I must bid you farewll for now. but I hope that we get to meet again.

I see... I am unsure whether to be relieved or not.
Please forgive me, I was mistaken.
I'm not sure what to do from here. Perhaps I ought to find somewhere to sleep, and allow recent events to settle in my mind.
I've been looking for my associate, Evans, for the past few weeks, and I believe I've managed to track him down. I am most certain that he has been taken inside this strange building.
If I had any strength remaining, I would aid you without question. I am no use to you in my current state.

It became far too dangerous to stay in that place, and I couldn't bring myself to harm Evans. I felt safer with the idea of taking my chances elsewhere... I wrote Evans a parting letter, and left him to his own devices.
It seems I've much searching yet to do. Forgive me, I have troubled you enough. Goodbye...

Months passed, and Evans eventually began to open portals into dark places, inviting tiny devils to come through. Tiny though they were, it took all of my strength, and that of the other pastors, to banish them.
My only regret in all of this is that I disappointed you.

Nikolai! My brother. I sensed the power of your emblem.
I hoped that you would find this place!
No. No...
Oh! You startled me. I was so engrossed in studying this wall, I didn't hear you step up.
Oh...
Once you see the beauty of this side, however, I am certain you will understand. The florid chaos! Remarkable!
Originally, we wanted to turn that abandoned building into a sanctuary for anyone who was struggling with life on the island, but we couldn't even make a start.
Please tell me, was Evans down there?
Thank you. I'm surprised you didn't sell it, but perhaps that's just me being cynical. We met a while ago near that old, run-down cottage, didn't we? I should have introduced myself then.

The other pastors and I did all we could to keep his gaze turned toward the light, but it was of little use. One of our congregation somehow learned of his dabblings, and all eight of our parish were put on trial for Malediction.
The seductive power of the dark arts must be greater even than I imagined. How could such a kind and virtuous man become so corrupted? I have no answers.

There is a magic circle etched onto its surface, and it's an exact match for the ones that Evans liked to draw in his journal. I noticed the same magic circle painted on the floor in that old cottage.

There is something suspicious about this wall, don't you think?
I would like to get inside and investigate, but I can't dispel the magic force protecting it.
This wall...

Urgh... I did not expect such a violent reaction.
I have... well overstrained myself.
Wait, that's...

Was that a cowardly thing to do? Perhaps. I am no killer though, and he was my friend. I thought perhaps I could find a way to put some sense into him, if I only had enough distance to collect my thoughts.
We have been apart for too long. Come to me, my dear brother!
What else must lie down there...

When I eventually returned, I found that everyone had taken their belongings and left. I kept wondering whether Evans had managed to turn himself around, and if the others were safe. I've been looking for any signs of them since. And so, that brings me to where I am now.
You have my sincere gratitude for granting Evans his final rest. There was nothing more to be done, and the Evans I knew would have wanted it this way.
You've returned!
... No? Well, maybe some other time. The offer shall remain open should you find yourself stuck here for too much longer.
Browse at your leisure, only keep the noise down, and don't carry lit torches near the books, please and thank you.
Fine, you can have the key. One didn't want it anyway.
Greetings! I am in your debt for removing that dreadful apparition from my lecture hall.
I got in trouble for yelling a profanity at the librarian. It was worth it.
I say! Stop making obscene gestures towards me at once!
I say, what was that ruckus just now? One is trying to read about the Great Turnip Shortage, you know.
Oh, do you need to get into the supply closet?
So! Have you have come to listen to my lectures? I cover an extensive range of subjects.
That Bogeyman has been rearranging our books and being a general nuisance for a long time, now. Thank you for getting rid of it.
The professor usually keeps the key on his desk. However, since monsters started appearing, he's given it to one of the senior students for safe keeping.
The seniors are usually in the private study area, behind the library reception desk.
The supply closet key? Yes, one has it right here, but why should one give it to you?
There have been many of its ilk lurking around here as of late, and I am stumped as to how they manage to get in. This place is meant to be a peaceful safe haven, protected from the outside world.
Today's lecture is an introduction to stenography!
You're new here, correct? You should talk to the professor--he's in the lecture hall just up ahead. He'll help you get settled in.
Blast
Dodge
Fight
Guard
Hunt
The exit is that way. I hope you're up to it.
Ward
You can press and hold F1 to get extra information on most screens. Give it a try here, and again after you leave.
, it says. He is... a living part of the island, who allows life or death, prosperity or suffering, only at his whim. That's rather bleak, isn't it?
A few spells, handwritten by a mage, it seems. It might be part of a larger volume, but it should be useful on its own.
